question: The temperature corresponding to Standard Temperature and Pressure(STP) in degree centigrade is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__0.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Standard temperature and pressure (STP)** refer to the **nominal conditions **in the atmosphere at sea level.
 
• These conditions are **0 degrees CelsiusU **__and 1 atmosphere (atm) of pressure.
 
• The STP value is important to** physicists, chemists, engineers, pilots, **and navigators, among others.
 
• Standard conditions for **temperature (T) and pressure (P) **refer to a specific pressure and temperature used to report on the properties of matter.
 
• STP values are** commonly used in experiments involving gases.**
